body:
## Summary

The `documents` profile keeps these names and personal attributes unchanged. Some have a detected counterpart (`Gender: female` is replaced, `Пол: женский` is not), and `docs/COVERAGE.md` does not list them as limits.

## Reproduction (0.16.0)

```js
import { sanitize } from '@link-foundation/sensitive-data-sanitizer';
const text = (s) => sanitize(s, { profile: 'documents' }).text;
```

All values below are invented.

### Names with initials

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `Смирнова А. В.` | unchanged |
| `Смирнова А.В., менеджер` | unchanged |
| `А. В. Смирнова` | unchanged |
| `Иванов И.И. написал` | unchanged |
| `Иванов И. написал` | unchanged |
| `Анна С.` | unchanged |
| `Smirnova A.V.` | unchanged |
| `A. V. Smirnova` | unchanged |
| `Anna S.` | unchanged |

The README says known values match initials (`Петров Д. С.`). These rows are about detection with no known value given.

### Full names in other cases, in lower case, or after a title

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `Смирновой Анной` | unchanged |
| `Анной Смирновой` | unchanged |
| `Смирновой А.В.` | unchanged |
| `смирнова анна` | unchanged |
| `г-жа Смирнова` | unchanged |
| `господин Смирнов` | unchanged |

The nominative is detected:

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `Смирнова Анна` | `[REDACTED]` |
| `Анна Викторовна` | `[REDACTED]` |

### A given name on its own

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `Спасибо, Анна!` | unchanged |
| `Анна, добрый день!` | unchanged |
| `Менеджер Анна` | unchanged |

`Меня зовут Анна` is detected. A bare given name is ambiguous, so documenting it as a limit would be fine here.

### Birth year

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `д.р. 1991` | unchanged |
| `1991 г.р.` | unchanged |
| `год рождения: 1991` | unchanged |
| `родился в 1991 году` | unchanged |
| `родилась в 1991` | unchanged |
| `Born in 1991` | unchanged |

### Age and gender

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `возраст: 34` | unchanged |
| `34 года` | unchanged |
| `мне 34 года` | unchanged |
| `Мне 34` | unchanged |
| `исполнилось 34` | unchanged |
| `Женщина, 34 года` | unchanged |
| `Мужчина, 41 год` | unchanged |
| `Пол: женский` | unchanged |
| `Пол: мужской` | unchanged |
| `Sex: male` | unchanged |

The English labels are detected, so the Russian labels look like a parity gap:

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `Age: 34` | `Age: [REDACTED]` |
| `Gender: female` | `Gender: [REDACTED]` |

### Other attributes after a label

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `Гражданство: Россия` | unchanged |
| `Citizenship: Russia` | unchanged |
| `Семейное положение: замужем, двое детей` | unchanged |
| `Marital status: married` | unchanged |
| `Дети: двое` | unchanged |
| `национальность: русская` | unchanged |
| `Вероисповедание: православие` | unchanged |
| `инвалидность: нет` | unchanged |
| `судимость: нет` | unchanged |

## Expected

These forms are replaced in the `documents` profile, or `docs/COVERAGE.md` lists each one as a known limit.

## Question

Salary is also kept (`зарплата 150 000 руб.`, `Salary: 150000`). It may be out of scope for this profile. If so, a line in `docs/COVERAGE.md` would settle it.

## Acceptance

- Each unchanged row above is replaced, or documented as a limit.
- Ordinary text stays unchanged: `Пол деревянный`, `пол часа`, `компания выросла на 34%`, `Россия заняла 3 место`, `Спасибо, команда!`, `м. б. завтра`.
